title: The Traditional Council, as recorded in 2021
metaDescription: The office holders of the Guneku Traditional Council as the community record named them in 2021, published as dated history and not as a statement of who holds office today.
sourceNote: Recorded 2026-09-02 from the community record of 2021. This is a dated roster, not a current one. The Palace has not confirmed who holds these offices today, and nothing here should be read as saying that these are the present office holders.
body:
The Guneku Traditional Council was reconstituted through quarter elections, and its councillors were installed on 30 July 2021. The site’s news archive carries the reorganisation itself, and the media archive holds forty-two photographs of the installation.

These are the office holders as the record named them in 2021.

  • Ndingwan Primus — Chairman
  • Fodom Calvin — Secretary, and quarter head of Fun
  • Amamuki Jonathan — Treasurer, and quarter head of Njinebai
  • Mbakwa Bernard — head of the 2021 Palace electoral commission
  • Ngwa Vitalis — secretary of that commission, and the Fon’s representative

Why the date is on the title

Five years have passed since this roster was recorded, and a traditional council changes. Publishing it as history keeps a real record of the village available without claiming something about the present that no source supports. If the Palace confirms the current holders, this record can be superseded rather than corrected.
leadImageAlt: Members of the Guneku Traditional Council standing together outside a thatched structure on the Palace grounds.
leadImageCaption: From the Fondom archive album of the installation of the Traditional Council, 30 July 2021.
